A small JiME Reborn campaign: two adventures at the old ford.
An open set to try the app without the original game.

[i]Greyford was always a quiet place: a ferry, an inn and the old road north. But this autumn the ferry stands idle and travellers vanish one by one. Armed men were seen by the river, they say - and something else, something that casts no shadow.[/i]
[i]The shade is gone, and the ferry creaks over the ford again. People will long remember the names of those who gave them back the road.[/i]
[i]The mist over the river grows thicker, and no one walks the north road any more. Perhaps others will come one day.[/i]
Bandits hold the ford. Find their camp.
[i]The ferryman vanished three days ago. The innkeeper asks you to find out who rules the ford now.[/i]
Place the heroes on the shown space.
[i]The road by the ford is empty. Fresh boot prints mark the sand.[/i]
Find 3 clues to track the bandits down.
Another clue. The picture slowly comes together.
[i]Every trail leads to the hills in the east. There, among the bushes, campfires smoulder.[/i]
[i]The camp is empty, the bandits fled. Among their loot is a map marking the old tower, and a strange black sign.[/i]
[i]You fall back to the inn. Yet you took a map from one of the bandits - with a mark at the old tower.[/i]
[i]Men with clubs step out of the bushes.[/i]
[i]Wolves howl in the distance, and the howling comes closer.[/i]
By the water the grass is trampled by many feet.
The tracks lead east, to the hills. A first clue.
The tracks get muddled. Try again later.
An old man sits on an upturned boat, watching the river.
It is the ferryman's helper. He clearly knows something.
The old man turns away. Maybe later.
The coin vanishes into his palm. Lose 1 lore.
"They took the ferryman to the hills. Their leader wears a black sign." A clue.
An overturned cart lies by the road.
Under the boards: a lantern and a scrap of a letter about "the camp beyond the hills". A clue!
The boards are too heavy. Come back later.
The bandits' camp: tents, fires, sentries.
Test [b]Might[/b] (2) to break into the camp.
[i]The sentries flee, and the camp is yours![/i]
[i]Alarm! Bandits pour out of the tents.[/i]
The black sign leads to the ruined tower.
[i]The tower has stood on the hill for centuries. Locals avoid it: at night, they say, a cold fire burns there.[/i]
Place the heroes on the shown space.
[i]It is cold at the foot of the tower, though the sun is still high.[/i]
Find the omens that show the way to the lair.
Find the altar and destroy it.
[i]The omen points to a path beyond the ruins.[/i]
[i]Now you know where the altar is: in the old hall, under the fallen roof.[/i]
[i]The altar cracks, and the Shade melts like smoke in the wind.[/i]
[i]The cold fire flares up. You flee the hill, and the Shade remains in the tower.[/i]
[i]The air rings with cold. Something has come for you.[/i]
The Shade knows you are here.

The raven looks north. The first omen.
The carving is worn. Come back later.
